issues.desc: index.json description field is stale relative to the rewritten background.md / checklist.json. It reads: "...adds a regression above the limit, and evaluates bounding the artifact itself." That is the exact soft-evaluation framing the rewrite explicitly rejected: background.md ## Solution Tradeoffs now says the growth item "must end in a BINDING outcome rather than a written opinion: either the artifact is bounded in this story, or a committed rationale records why unbounded growth is acceptable and names the change that will address it," and checklist.json CHK-004 title is "Bound the aggregate evidence artifact or commit a rationale naming the change that will, and ship whichever the decision is" (context explicitly warns "Closing this item with a written opinion and no shipped consequence is exactly the unexamined growth cliff this story exists to end"). A reader who consults only index.json description (the field this INIT dimension checks for standalone consistency) would conclude CHK-004 is a paper evaluation -- precisely the defect class the prior review round already flagged against the old CHK-004 title before it was retitled. index.json.description was not updated in the rewrite. Separately, index.json.description also does not mention the CHK-005 deliverable (the near-limit advisory) at all, so it undersells scope on two of the five checklist items.
